<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[api.controller = function($scope,$timeout,$location,nowAttachmentHandler) {
  var c = this;

  c.filters = {};
  c.loading = false;
  c.refreshing = false;
  c.uploading = false;
  c.submitting = false;
  c.sortDescending = true;

  c.showCompletionForm = false;
  c.attachmentButtonVisible = false;

  c.successMessage = "";
  c.errorMessage = "";
  c.formError = "";
  c.uploadMessage = "";

  c.selectedRecord = {};
  c.completionForm = {};
  c.attachments = [];

  /*
   * Request number autocomplete variables.
   */
  c.requestSearch = "";
  c.showRequestDropdown = false;
  c.filteredRequestNumbers = [];
  c.activeRequestIndex = -1;

  c.displayRecords = angular.copy(
    c.data.records || []
  );

  $scope.attachmentHandler = null;

  initializeRequestNumbers();

  function initializeRequestNumbers() {
    var requestNumbers = [];

    if (
      c.data.filterOptions &&
      c.data.filterOptions.requestNumbers
    ) {
      requestNumbers =
        c.data.filterOptions.requestNumbers;
    }

    c.filteredRequestNumbers =
      angular.copy(requestNumbers);
  }

  function updateDisplayRecords(records) {
    var updatedRecords = records || [];

    c.data.records = updatedRecords;
    c.displayRecords = updatedRecords.slice(0);

    if (!c.sortDescending) {
      c.displayRecords.reverse();
    }
  }

  /*
   * Request number autocomplete.
   */
  c.filterRequestNumbers = function() {
    var searchValue = String(
      c.requestSearch || ""
    ).trim().toLowerCase();

    var requestNumbers =
      c.data.filterOptions &&
      c.data.filterOptions.requestNumbers
        ? c.data.filterOptions.requestNumbers
        : [];

    c.filters.requestNumber =
      String(c.requestSearch || "").trim();

    if (!searchValue) {
      c.filteredRequestNumbers =
        angular.copy(requestNumbers);
    } else {
      c.filteredRequestNumbers =
        requestNumbers.filter(function(number) {
          return String(number)
            .toLowerCase()
            .indexOf(searchValue) !== -1;
        });
    }

    c.activeRequestIndex = -1;
    c.showRequestDropdown = true;
  };

  c.openRequestDropdown = function() {
    c.filterRequestNumbers();
    c.showRequestDropdown = true;
  };

  c.toggleRequestDropdown = function(event) {
    if (event) {
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
    }

    c.showRequestDropdown =
      !c.showRequestDropdown;

    if (c.showRequestDropdown) {
      c.filterRequestNumbers();
    }
  };

  c.hideRequestDropdown = function() {
    $timeout(function() {
      c.showRequestDropdown = false;
      c.activeRequestIndex = -1;
    }, 200);
  };

  c.selectRequestNumber = function(
    requestNumber,
    event
  ) {
    if (event) {
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
    }

    c.requestSearch = requestNumber || "";
    c.filters.requestNumber =
      requestNumber || "";

    c.showRequestDropdown = false;
    c.activeRequestIndex = -1;
  };

  c.clearRequestNumber = function(event) {
    if (event) {
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
    }

    c.requestSearch = "";
    c.filters.requestNumber = "";
    c.activeRequestIndex = -1;

    initializeRequestNumbers();

    c.showRequestDropdown = true;
  };

  c.handleRequestKeydown = function(event) {
    if (!event) {
      return;
    }

    var keyCode = event.which || event.keyCode;
    var options =
      c.filteredRequestNumbers || [];

    /*
     * Down arrow.
     */
    if (keyCode === 40) {
      event.preventDefault();

      c.showRequestDropdown = true;

      if (!options.length) {
        return;
      }

      c.activeRequestIndex++;

      if (
        c.activeRequestIndex >= options.length
      ) {
        c.activeRequestIndex = 0;
      }

      return;
    }

    /*
     * Up arrow.
     */
    if (keyCode === 38) {
      event.preventDefault();

      if (!options.length) {
        return;
      }

      c.activeRequestIndex--;

      if (c.activeRequestIndex < 0) {
        c.activeRequestIndex =
          options.length - 1;
      }

      return;
    }

    /*
     * Enter.
     */
    if (keyCode === 13) {
      event.preventDefault();

      if (
        c.showRequestDropdown &&
        c.activeRequestIndex >= 0 &&
        options[c.activeRequestIndex]
      ) {
        c.selectRequestNumber(
          options[c.activeRequestIndex]
        );
      }

      c.search();
      return;
    }

    /*
     * Escape.
     */
    if (keyCode === 27) {
      c.showRequestDropdown = false;
      c.activeRequestIndex = -1;
    }
  };

  c.openView = function(record) {
    if (!record || !record.sys_id) {
      return;
    }

    $location.url(
      "?id=view_record_asean&sys_id=" +
      encodeURIComponent(record.sys_id)
    );
  };

  c.openEdit = function(record) {
    if (!record || !record.sys_id) {
      return;
    }

    if (record.statusValue !== "draft") {
      c.errorMessage =
        "Only Draft applications can be edited.";
      return;
    }

    $location.url(
      "?id=edit_registration_asean&sys_id=" +
      encodeURIComponent(record.sys_id)
    );
  };

  c.openFeedback = function(record) {
    if (!record || !record.sys_id) {
      return;
    }

    if (
      record.statusValue !== "pending_feedback"
    ) {
      c.errorMessage =
        "Feedback is available only for " +
        "Pending Feedback applications.";
      return;
    }

    $location.url(
      "?id=feedback_asean&sys_id=" +
      encodeURIComponent(record.sys_id)
    );
  };

  c.goBack = function() {
    $location.url("?id=employee_role_asean");
  };

  c.search = function() {
    if (c.loading || c.refreshing) {
      return;
    }

    /*
     * Use typed text even when user does not
     * select an item from the dropdown.
     */
    c.filters.requestNumber = String(
      c.requestSearch || ""
    ).trim();

    c.showRequestDropdown = false;
    c.loading = true;
    c.errorMessage = "";

    c.server.get({
      action: "search",
      filters: angular.copy(c.filters)
    }).then(
      function(response) {
        updateDisplayRecords(
          response.data.records || []
        );

        if (
          response.data.success === false &&
          response.data.message
        ) {
          c.errorMessage =
            response.data.message;
        }

        c.loading = false;
      },
      function() {
        c.loading = false;
        c.errorMessage =
          "Unable to search the learning applications.";
      }
    );
  };

  c.reset = function() {
    if (c.loading || c.refreshing) {
      return;
    }

    c.filters = {};
    c.requestSearch = "";
    c.showRequestDropdown = false;
    c.activeRequestIndex = -1;

    c.sortDescending = true;
    c.loading = true;
    c.errorMessage = "";

    c.server.get({
      action: "reset",
      filters: {}
    }).then(
      function(response) {
        updateDisplayRecords(
          response.data.records || []
        );

        if (response.data.filterOptions) {
          c.data.filterOptions =
            response.data.filterOptions;
        }

        initializeRequestNumbers();

        c.loading = false;
      },
      function() {
        c.loading = false;
        c.errorMessage =
          "Unable to reset the learning applications.";
      }
    );
  };

  c.refresh = function() {
    if (c.refreshing || c.loading) {
      return;
    }

    c.filters.requestNumber = String(
      c.requestSearch || ""
    ).trim();

    c.showRequestDropdown = false;
    c.refreshing = true;
    c.errorMessage = "";

    var refreshTimeout = $timeout(
      function() {
        if (c.refreshing) {
          c.refreshing = false;
          c.errorMessage =
            "Refresh took too long. Please try again.";
        }
      },
      15000
    );

    c.server.get({
      action: "refresh",
      filters: angular.copy(c.filters)
    }).then(
      function(response) {
        $timeout.cancel(refreshTimeout);

        updateDisplayRecords(
          response.data.records || []
        );

        if (response.data.filterOptions) {
          c.data.filterOptions =
            response.data.filterOptions;

          initializeRequestNumbers();
        }

        c.refreshing = false;
      },
      function() {
        $timeout.cancel(refreshTimeout);

        c.refreshing = false;
        c.errorMessage =
          "Unable to refresh the learning applications.";
      }
    );
  };

  c.toggleSort = function() {
    if (c.loading || c.refreshing) {
      return;
    }

    c.sortDescending = !c.sortDescending;
    c.displayRecords.reverse();
  };

  c.getStatusClass = function(statusValue) {
    switch (statusValue) {
      case "draft":
        return "status-draft";

      case "submitted":
        return "status-submitted";

      case "pending_manager_approval":
      case "pending_l2_approval":
      case "pending_hr_review":
        return "status-approval";

      case "approved":
        return "status-approved";

      case "learning_in_progress":
        return "status-progress";

      case "pending_feedback":
        return "status-feedback";

      case "completed":
        return "status-complete";

      case "rejected":
        return "status-rejected";

      default:
        return "status-default";
    }
  };

  c.openCompletionForm = function(record) {
    if (!record || !record.sys_id) {
      return;
    }

    if (
      record.statusValue !==
      "learning_in_progress"
    ) {
      c.errorMessage =
        "Certificate upload is available only for " +
        "Learning In Progress applications.";
      return;
    }

    c.formError = "";
    c.uploadMessage = "";
    c.successMessage = "";
    c.errorMessage = "";
    c.attachments = [];
    c.attachmentButtonVisible = false;

    c.selectedRecord =
      angular.copy(record);

    c.completionForm = {
      requestNumber:
        record.requestNumber || "",
      employeeName:
        record.employeeName || "",
      courseTitle:
        record.courseTitle || "",
      courseStartDate:
        record.courseStartDate || "",
      courseEndDate:
        record.courseEndDate || "",
      completionComment: ""
    };

    initializeAttachmentHandler(
      record.sys_id
    );

    c.showCompletionForm = true;

    $timeout(function() {
      c.attachmentButtonVisible = true;
      c.loadAttachments();
    }, 100);
  };

  function initializeAttachmentHandler(sysId) {
    function attachmentSuccess(
      attachments,
      action
    ) {
      c.uploading = false;
      c.attachments = attachments || [];

      if (action === "added") {
        c.uploadMessage =
          "Certificate uploaded successfully.";
      }

      if (action === "deleted") {
        c.uploadMessage =
          "Certificate removed successfully.";
      }

      c.loadAttachments();
      $scope.$evalAsync();
    }

    function attachmentError(error) {
      c.uploading = false;

      if (error && error.msg) {
        c.formError =
          error.msg +
          (
            error.fileName
              ? " " + error.fileName
              : ""
          );
      } else {
        c.formError =
          "Certificate upload failed.";
      }

      $scope.$evalAsync();
    }

    $scope.attachmentHandler =
      new nowAttachmentHandler(
        attachmentSuccess,
        attachmentError
      );

    $scope.attachmentHandler.setParams(
      "x_1549902_asean_0_learning_application",
      sysId,
      10 * 1024 * 1024
    );
  }

  $scope.$on(
    "dialog.upload_too_large.show",
    function() {
      c.uploading = false;
      c.formError =
        "The certificate exceeds the maximum " +
        "allowed size of 10 MB.";

      $scope.$evalAsync();
    }
  );

  $scope.$on(
    "attachment.upload.start",
    function() {
      c.uploading = true;
      c.formError = "";
      c.uploadMessage = "";

      $scope.$evalAsync();
    }
  );

  $scope.$on(
    "sp.attachments.update",
    function() {
      c.uploading = false;

      if (
        c.showCompletionForm &&
        c.selectedRecord &&
        c.selectedRecord.sys_id
      ) {
        c.loadAttachments();
      }
    }
  );

  c.loadAttachments = function() {
    if (
      !c.showCompletionForm ||
      !c.selectedRecord ||
      !c.selectedRecord.sys_id
    ) {
      return;
    }

    c.server.get({
      action: "get_attachments",
      sys_id: c.selectedRecord.sys_id
    }).then(
      function(response) {
        c.attachments =
          response.data.attachments || [];

        c.uploading = false;

        if (
          response.data.success === false &&
          response.data.message
        ) {
          c.formError =
            response.data.message;
        }
      },
      function() {
        c.uploading = false;
        c.formError =
          "Unable to load uploaded certificates.";
      }
    );
  };

  c.deleteAttachment = function(
    attachment
  ) {
    if (
      !$scope.attachmentHandler ||
      !attachment
    ) {
      return;
    }

    c.formError = "";
    c.uploadMessage = "";

    $scope.attachmentHandler
      .deleteAttachment(attachment);
  };

  c.submitForFeedback = function() {
    if (c.submitting || c.uploading) {
      return;
    }

    c.formError = "";
    c.uploadMessage = "";

    var completionComment =
      c.completionForm.completionComment
        ? String(
            c.completionForm.completionComment
          ).trim()
        : "";

    if (!completionComment) {
      c.formError =
        "Completion Comments are mandatory.";
      return;
    }

    if (
      !c.attachments ||
      c.attachments.length === 0
    ) {
      c.formError =
        "Please upload the completion certificate.";
      return;
    }

    c.submitting = true;

    c.server.get({
      action: "submit_for_feedback",
      sys_id: c.selectedRecord.sys_id,

      form: {
        requestNumber:
          c.completionForm.requestNumber,

        employeeName:
          c.completionForm.employeeName,

        courseTitle:
          c.completionForm.courseTitle,

        courseStartDate:
          c.completionForm.courseStartDate,

        courseEndDate:
          c.completionForm.courseEndDate,

        completionComment:
          completionComment
      },

      filters: angular.copy(c.filters)
    }).then(
      function(response) {
        c.submitting = false;

        if (response.data.success) {
          c.attachmentButtonVisible = false;
          $scope.attachmentHandler = null;
          c.attachments = [];

          c.successMessage =
            response.data.message ||
            "Certificate and comments submitted successfully.";

          updateDisplayRecords(
            response.data.records || []
          );

          $timeout(function() {
            c.showCompletionForm = false;
            c.selectedRecord = {};
            c.completionForm = {};
          }, 50);

          $timeout(function() {
            c.successMessage = "";
          }, 7000);
        } else {
          c.formError =
            response.data.message ||
            "Unable to update the learning application.";
        }
      },
      function() {
        c.submitting = false;
        c.formError =
          "An unexpected error occurred while submitting.";
      }
    );
  };

  c.overlayClick = function(event) {
    if (
      event &&
      event.target !== event.currentTarget
    ) {
      return;
    }

    c.closeCompletionForm();
  };

  c.closeCompletionForm = function() {
    if (c.submitting || c.uploading) {
      return;
    }

    c.attachmentButtonVisible = false;
    $scope.attachmentHandler = null;
    c.attachments = [];
    c.formError = "";
    c.uploadMessage = "";

    $timeout(function() {
      c.showCompletionForm = false;
      c.selectedRecord = {};
      c.completionForm = {};
    }, 50);
  };
};]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>.learning-records-page {

      !gr.isValidField(fieldName)

      array.indexOf(value) === -1

      array.push(value);

  function addUniqueObject(
    array,
    value,
    displayValue

    if (!value) {
      return;
    }

    for (var i = 0; i < array.length; i++) {

    array.push({
      value: value,
      display: displayValue || value

    gr.orderByDesc("sys_created_on");
    gr.query();

    while (gr.next()) {
      addUnique(
        data.filterOptions.requestNumbers,
        getDisplay(gr, "number")

        data.filterOptions.courseTypes,
        getValue(gr, "u_course_type"),
        getDisplay(gr, "u_course_type")
      );

      addUniqueObject(
        data.filterOptions.courseFormats,
        getValue(gr, "u_course_format"),
        getDisplay(gr, "u_course_format")
      );

        courseFee:
          getDisplay(
            gr,
            "u_course_fee"
          ),

        otherExpenses:
          getDisplay(
            gr,
            "u_other_expenses"

        approval:
          getDisplay(
            gr,
            "approval"

        openedAt:
          getDisplay(
            gr,

          ),

  function loadAttachments(parentSysId) {

        ),

        sizeDisplay =
          (
            sizeBytes /
            (1024 * 1024)
          ).toFixed(2) +
          " MB";
      } else {
        sizeDisplay =
          (
            sizeBytes /
            1024
          ).toFixed(2) +
          " KB";
      }

      data.attachments.push({
        sys_id:
          attachmentGr.getUniqueValue(),

        file_name:
          attachmentGr.getValue(
            "file_name"
          ),

        content_type:
          attachmentGr.getValue(

          ),

        size_bytes:

        size:
          sizeDisplay

    attachmentGr.query();

    attachmentGr.addQuery(
